scenes.tts: A sound comes before juice, every time. Once a monkey learns that, when does a dopamine neuron fire?
scenes.visual: A monkey at a juice spout beside a speaker. Title card: The tone and the juice.
scenes.narration: A sound comes before juice, every time. Once a monkey learns that, when does a dopamine neuron fire?

scenes.tts: Wolfram Schultz's group recorded single dopamine neurons in the midbrain of monkeys.
scenes.visual: A fine electrode descends to a single midbrain neuron. Label: single-unit recording.
scenes.narration: Wolfram Schultz's group recorded single dopamine neurons in the midbrain of monkeys.

scenes.tts: A fine electrode beside one neuron picks up its spikes, as the monkey gets drops of juice.
scenes.visual: Spikes appear as ticks on a trace as juice drops fall.
scenes.narration: A fine electrode beside one neuron picks up its spikes, as the monkey gets drops of juice.

scenes.tts: In this picture, each row is one trial, and each tick one spike, lined up on an event.
scenes.visual: A raster builds row by row, aligned to a vertical event line, with a histogram beneath.
scenes.narration: In this picture, each row is one trial, and each tick one spike, lined up on an event.

scenes.tts: First, juice arrives with no warning. About three quarters of the recorded neurons fired a brief burst.
scenes.visual: Panel A: juice with no warning; a column of extra ticks at the juice. On screen: about 3/4 of neurons, two monkeys.
scenes.narration: First, juice arrives with no warning. About three quarters of the recorded neurons fired a brief burst.

scenes.tts: Then a sound began to predict the juice. Once the monkeys learned that, the burst came at the sound.
scenes.visual: Panel B: tone, then juice; the column of ticks sits at the tone. Label: Mirenowicz and Schultz, 1994.
scenes.narration: Then a sound began to predict the juice. Once the monkeys learned that, the burst came at the sound.

scenes.tts: The juice itself, now expected, got little or no burst.
scenes.visual: Panel B: little or nothing at the juice.
scenes.narration: The juice itself, now expected, got little or no burst.

scenes.tts: Why should the burst move? Picture one trial as a strip of moments.
scenes.visual: A horizontal strip of boxes: waiting, tone, delay, juice.
scenes.narration: Why should the burst move? Picture one trial as a strip of moments.

scenes.tts: Waiting, then the tone, a one second delay, then the juice.
scenes.visual: The strip labels light up in order. On screen: 1 s delay.
scenes.caption: Waiting, then the tone, a one-second delay, then the juice.
scenes.narration: Waiting, then the tone, a one-second delay, then the juice.

scenes.tts: Give each moment its own prediction of the reward still to come.
scenes.visual: A prediction bar rises above each box of the strip.
scenes.narration: Give each moment its own prediction of the reward still to come.

scenes.tts: Before the tone, the model sets the prediction to zero. That is a simplifying choice. The tone itself comes at unpredictable times.
scenes.visual: Bars before the tone stay flat. On screen: V = 0 (model choice).
scenes.narration: Before the tone, the model sets the prediction to zero. That is a simplifying choice. The tone itself comes at unpredictable times.

scenes.tts: From the tone until the juice, the prediction is high. Juice is coming.
scenes.visual: Bars from tone to juice stand full. On screen: V = 1.
scenes.narration: From the tone until the juice, the prediction is high. Juice is coming.

scenes.tts: After the juice, the prediction drops back. The trial is over.
scenes.visual: Bars after the juice fall flat. On screen: V = 0.
scenes.narration: After the juice, the prediction drops back. The trial is over.

scenes.tts: The error at each step is the reward that arrived, plus the change in the prediction.
scenes.visual: On screen: δ = r + V(next moment) − V(this moment). Small label: no discounting here.
scenes.narration: The error at each step is the reward that arrived, plus the change in the prediction.

scenes.tts: At the tone, no reward arrives, but the prediction jumps up. That jump is an error, and a burst.
scenes.visual: The step from flat to full bars at the tone glows; a burst of ticks appears. On screen: δ = +1.
scenes.narration: At the tone, no reward arrives, but the prediction jumps up. That jump is an error, and a burst.

scenes.tts: During the delay, nothing changes. No error.
scenes.visual: Flat full bars; steady ticks. On screen: δ = 0.
scenes.narration: During the delay, nothing changes. No error.

scenes.tts: At the juice, the reward arrives, but the prediction falls by the same amount. They cancel. No burst.
scenes.visual: Juice drop and falling bar meet; steady ticks. On screen: δ = 1 + 0 − 1 = 0.
scenes.narration: At the juice, the reward arrives, but the prediction falls by the same amount. They cancel. No burst.

scenes.tts: So unexpected good news about the future makes an error, just as reward itself does.
scenes.visual: Caption card: unexpected good news about the future = an error.
scenes.narration: So unexpected good news about the future makes an error, just as reward itself does.

scenes.tts: Now the tone sounds, and the juice never comes. What happens at the moment it was due?
scenes.visual: Tone sounds; the spout stays dry. A question mark at the juice time.
scenes.narration: Now the tone sounds, and the juice never comes. What happens at the moment it was due?

scenes.visual: The question stays on screen; a small countdown ring runs.

scenes.tts: The prediction still falls, but no reward makes up for it. The error is negative.
scenes.visual: The bar falls at the juice time with no juice. On screen: δ = 0 + 0 − 1 = −1.
scenes.narration: The prediction still falls, but no reward makes up for it. The error is negative.

scenes.tts: Firing pauses at about the time the juice was due. Hollerman and Schultz recorded it.
scenes.visual: Raster: burst at the tone, a gap at the juice time. Label: Hollerman and Schultz, 1998.
scenes.narration: Firing pauses at about the time the juice was due. Hollerman and Schultz recorded it.

scenes.tts: In the model, add a light that comes at unpredictable times, always two seconds before the tone. After learning, the burst moves to the light.
scenes.visual: Label: in the model. A light icon appears before the tone on the strip; the burst slides to the light.
scenes.narration: In the model, add a light that comes at unpredictable times, always two seconds before the tone. After learning, the burst moves to the light.

scenes.tts: Now the tone is already expected, so it adds no error. The burst goes to the first cue nothing else predicted.
scenes.visual: Label: first cue that nothing else predicted. The tone box stays dark.
scenes.narration: Now the tone is already expected, so it adds no error. The burst goes to the first cue nothing else predicted.

scenes.tts: A recording shows only that firing matches the error. Does the burst actually teach?
scenes.visual: Caption card: recording = correlation.
scenes.narration: A recording shows only that firing matches the error. Does the burst actually teach?

scenes.tts: In rats, a cue added alongside one that already predicts reward is normally learned poorly. A burst imposed with light at reward made them respond to it more. That shows an imposed burst is enough, not that natural bursts are needed.
scenes.visual: A rat with a fibre over the midbrain; light pulses at reward; a second cue gains a glow. Label: Steinberg and colleagues, 2013.
scenes.narration: In rats, a cue added alongside one that already predicts reward is normally learned poorly. A burst imposed with light at reward made them respond to it more. That shows an imposed burst is enough, not that natural bursts are needed.

scenes.tts: The error is the reward plus the change in prediction. After training, it comes at the first cue nothing else predicted.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: δ = r + V(next) − V(now); after training, the burst sits at the first cue nothing else predicted.
scenes.narration: The error is the reward plus the change in prediction. After training, it comes at the first cue nothing else predicted.
